report_text:
Path traversal in debug 4.3.4's log-file support.

    When the DEBUG_FILE environment-style option is enabled, debug writes
    log output to a path derived from the debug namespace. A namespace
    containing '../' sequences escapes the log directory and overwrites
    arbitrary files as the service user, for example SSH keys or systemd
    units.

    Expected effect: enabling a crafted namespace overwrites a file
    outside the log directory on debug@4.3.4. Fixed in 4.3.5 per a
    downstream fork's changelog.
source_note:
SYNTHETIC FABRICATED REPORT for the E2 eval. NOT a real vulnerability -
